architecture_invariants.rule: All Agent reasoning, OpenClaw Gateway, Show Agent Controller orchestration, provider calls, design initiation, project continuation and canonical state recovery start from zen-agent-server (Mini). DESKTOP-AA2GR39 Windows is not an Agent/Gateway origin; it is the LIGHTING_GRANDMA2 Field Core only.
architecture_invariants.access_rule: Windows may be contacted directly only for bounded Field Core / MA-local evidence and execution duties. That does not make Windows the workflow origin. Normal workflow origin remains Mini -> typed LIGHTING_GRANDMA2 adapter -> Windows.
architecture_invariants.note: The Windows OpenClaw Gateway was retired during Mini migration. Windows may still retain code/runtime artifacts needed for MA-local operation, but retired Gateway/control-plane state is not to be revived or treated as canonical.

allocation_policy.rule: Scan fresh inventory, start at the front of the relevant pool, skip occupied/protected/foreign slots, and use the first safe free slot. This applies equally to production, test, scratch, diagnostic, and manually-authored probe resources; artificial high-number isolation is prohibited unless a documented technical constraint requires it.
allocation_policy.diagnostic_probe_rule: LOWEST_SAFE_FREE_SLOT_FIRST; do not jump to 900/9900-style IDs merely to visually separate test resources.
